app_info.subtitle: Find leads and run outreach
app_info.description: MisarReach lets users find and enrich B2B leads, verify email addresses, qualify and score prospects, run multi-channel outreach sequences, and manage the sales pipeline — from ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves or computes data to return to the user; it does not change MisarReach records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reaches the hosted MisarReach API over the network, so results depend on live account state outside this conversation.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, revoke or irreversibly overwrite anything; any change it makes can be undone by a subsequent call.
